reviews.title: Cool idea
reviews.text:
Not sure why there are so many 5 star reviews, it’s just generic info it gives you regardless of the type on content you’re making. 

I uploaded my worst performing video (under 300 views) and one that went viral and it rated them the same. Its analysis of the videos wasn’t accurate. 

It just recommends hashtags based on text in the video which I guess is alright if you just can’t think of hashtags but they are in no way specialized just gives you a big list. 

Here is what it recommended for my video caption “Bold text drops in the opening second with the claim. The dancers repeat the same walk along the hill as the sunset glows. The contrast between the claim and movement invites curiosity and repeat viewing” like what?….

The posting time is also just a generic thing. Shows you when there’s the most traffic and is in no way specialized to your content specifically so not much help there. Just because there’s more people on at a certain time doesn’t mean that’s the best time for your target audience.

reviews.title: Generic slop Mostly
reviews.text: The only tool I found unique was the when to post tool. Everything was a waste of time. The video analysis tool is BS! I tested uploading the same exact same video multiple times and the score changed every single time. The advice is so generic. Gemini and ChatGPT give much better content advice that you can better target to your specific audience. The ONE time I applied the notes this app gave me for a post was the worst reach of any video ever & cost me hours of my life in editing. I reposted my original edit and it had more than 3x the reach. I think this is a “shiny object” situation and would honestly not recommend.

reviews.title: Let me save you from this
reviews.text:
If you’re in anyway tempted to try this for the 1st time or even given another try after a year or so BE WARNED ⛔️The app shows “Start your free trial now!” but charges immediately with no disclosure. There is no notice that you’re ineligible, no pricing on the screen, and no warning that pressing Continue equals a paid subscription.

Support later claimed I had used a trial over a year ago…information that should have been disclosed upfront. Advertising a free trial and then charging instantly is misleading.

This kind of dark-pattern billing erodes trust. I would not recommend this app.
